# Bundled browser encoder

`qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js` is the unmodified official Project Nayuki v1.8.0
release asset, downloaded from:
https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js

SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`

The MIT license and copyright notice are in the file and retained in the HTML.
The build verifies the digest. No library is fetched when the HTML opens.
